SELECT DISTINCT i.`USERID` userId, i.`FULLNAME` userName, i.`EMPLOYEE` employee, i.`COMPANY` companyName, i.`COMPANYID` companyId, i.`DEPARTMENT` departmentName, i.`DEPARTMENTID` departmentId, i.`TITLE` postName, i.`USERPOSILEVEL` postLevel, i.`EMAIL` email, i.`TELEPHONE` telephone, concat(year(i.LASTMODIFYTIME),'年') as lastYear, i.`USERBIRTHDAY` userBirthday, i.`USERJOININDATE` userJoinInWorkDate, i.`USERRELIGION` userReligion, r.DEPT_REMARK deptRemark, r.FILE_KEY fileKey, r.FILE_NAME fileName, case when (select count(t.PERSON_ID) from xuncha_task_group_person_info t where i.USERID=t.PERSONNEL_ID) =0 then r.INSPECTION_YEAR else (select group_concat(distinct year(t.CREATED_TIME)) from xuncha_task_group_person_info t where i.USERID=t.PERSONNEL_ID) end as inspectionYear, (SELECT count(t.PERSONNEL_ID) FROM xuncha_task_group_person_info t WHERE i.USERID=t.PERSONNEL_ID) as inspectionTimes FROM uum_userinfo i LEFT JOIN xuncha_talent_person_info r ON r.USER_ID=i.USERID
and i.USERID =#{userId} and i.FULLNAME like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') and i.EMPLOYEE like concat('%', #{employee}, '%') and i.COMPANYID =#{companyId} and i.DEPARTMENT like concat('%', #{departmentName}, '%') and i.DEPARTMENTID =#{departmentId} and i.USERPOSILEVEL =#{postLevel} and i.COMPANY like concat('%', #{companyName}, '%') and i.USERRELIGION =#{userReligion} and i.USERRELIGION_NAME like concat('%', #{userReligionName}, '%')
